author: DonaldMyTrump
body: As I stated in my last appeal the rules were not being enforced on that scrim server and other users were spamming and using profanities. Since Para locked it stating warns and verbal warns are interchangable but I recieved a kick not a warn or verbal warn I decided to remake it.

title: Appeal for my kick

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
Hello Zac, 

Please refer to your last appeal. I will look into this situation and look for those others you mentioned but just because someone else is doing it doesn't give you the right to do so as well. Next time please report these users and provide evidence so we can punish said players.

Appeal denied

Regards,
GrapeSmoothie, Senior Moderator
